verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows generic marketing links to 'Ryzen AI Software For Developers' but never states that the 9950X3D itself contains an NPU, nor gives any TOPS figure or precision spec, nor confirms an SDK/runtime ships for this specific chip (Ryzen AI is typically a mobile-chip NPU feature). Missing for 10: NPU presence confirmation on this SKU, a published TOPS figure with precision, and evidence of a shipping SDK/runtime tied to this desktop chip.
